# Version 4.156.3 (Unreleased)
> **Native rendering and allocation safety**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.3 integrates upstream fixes for image filtering, glyph rendering and GPU allocation safety. This servicing update keeps the managed API and native C ABI unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Cleaner image filters and bounded destination reads** — Ganesh image filtering avoids mipmaps that could incorporate unwritten scratch-texture contents. Draws that read the destination are clipped to their destination-read bounds, including when geometry overshoots calculated draw bounds. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **Correct glyph cropping and painter order** — FreeType LCD16 glyph copies use consistent pixel-space bounds and crop to the valid overlap when successive loads produce different outlines. Graphite resets depth and bounds tracking after overwriting draws so depth wrap does not reorder rendering. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **Reject invalid Ganesh buffer allocations** — Checked alignment and size arithmetic prevents overflowing allocation requests and out-of-bounds padding writes. Invalid or failed allocations skip the draw rather than proceeding with an invalid buffer. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
